paragraphs: GL Solutions builds and sells regulatory software to government agencies, with the stated aim of helping them modernize, digitize and automate the systems they already run. Its platform, GL Suite, was developed by former regulatory officials and automates each step of a licensing process.

The company describes GL Suite as configurable, positioning it as a way for agencies to run, grow and adapt. Alongside the software sits an Agency Transformation service, presented as guidance along the path to modernization rather than a one-off fix. On security, GovRAMP awarded the product GovRAMP Ready status.

Customers are state and local bodies, with the company saying GL Suite is digitizing operations for scores of local and state government agencies and departments nationwide. Listed agency types include medical, dentistry, chiropractic and pharmacy boards. The case studies page names clients such as the Nevada State Board of Accountancy. The company traces itself to founders who cofounded GL Solutions in 1997 to help government agencies function better. It describes itself as an employee-owned corporation.

quote.text: GL Solutions digitizes operations for regulatory agencies, boosting efficiency since 1998.
